description: Older name for ship_check, kept for existing callers. Same scan, same input, same result. Prefer ship_check. Fits questions like: Is my Lovable app safe to launch? Are my API keys exposed on my live site?

fresh.description: Skip the 24h cache and scan again (use after deploying a fix).

url.description: The live, publicly reachable URL of the deployed app, e.g. https://my-app.lovable.app. A bare domain gets https://.

name: leak_check

scan_id.description: Pass to request_human_review. Null if the result could not be stored.

score.description: 0-100. Each red finding costs 30 points, each yellow 10, each untested check 4; capped at 50 when more than half the checks could not be tested.

title: Leak Check (older name for ship_check)
